title: Complete the Lean Formalization of Erdős Problem #507 (Heilbronn's Triangle Problem)

problemStatement.plain: Heilbronn's triangle problem asks for the growth of α(n): the largest value such that some configuration of n points in the unit disk keeps every triangle (over triples of points) of area at least α(n). Equivalently, over all n-point sets one maximizes the minimum triangle area. The trivial bounds are 1/n² ≪ α(n) ≪ 1/n; Komlós–Pintz–Szemerédi improved these to (log n)/n² ≤ α(n) ≤ n^{-8/7}, and Cohen–Pohoata–Zakharov (2024) pushed the upper bound to n^{-7/6-o(1)}. The exponent β with α(n)=n^{-β+o(1)} is only known to satisfy 7/6 ≤ β ≤ 2 — the problem is OPEN. The Lean file Erdos507Problem.lean defines triangleArea, IsInUnitDisk, minTriangleArea and heilbronn but proves nothing; this WIP node formalizes the elementary geometry of the building block triangleArea.
whyMatters: Heilbronn's problem is a flagship open question in discrete/incidence geometry; a clean Lean treatment of the shoelace area and its symmetries seeds reusable planar-geometry infrastructure.

# Knowledge Base: erdos-507-wip-01

## Session 2026-07-20 (researcher-1) — foundational triangle-area / unit-disk scaffolding

**Mode**: FRESH (EMPTY node). **Outcome**: progress — VERIFIED axiom-free (`[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`), 0 sorry / 0 axiom. Host-verified (Mathlib-only parent): fresh-built `Erdos507Problem.olean` then `lake env lean` on the child (no Docker).

### What I did
Created `proofs/Proofs/Erdos507WIP01.lean` (14 theorems) on the shoelace area `triangleArea p q r = |p₁(q₂−r₂)+q₁(r₂−p₂)+r₁(p₂−q₂)|/2` and the `IsInUnitDisk` predicate:
- **Nonnegativity**: `triangleArea_nonneg`.
- **Permutation symmetry**: `triangleArea_swap_left`, `triangleArea_swap_right` (transpositions, via signed-area negation + `abs_neg`), `triangleArea_cyclic` (rotation fixes it).
- **Degenerate cases**: `triangleArea_self_left / _self_mid / _self_outer` (= 0).
- **Collinearity**: `triangleArea_eq_zero_iff`.
- **Explicit value**: `triangleArea_unit` (`(0,0),(1,0),(0,1) ↦ 1/2`).
- **Unit disk**: `isInUnitDisk_empty`, `IsInUnitDisk.subset`, `unitDisk_abs_fst_le`, `unitDisk_abs_snd_le`, and the uniform bound `triangleArea_le_three`.

### Key findings
- The signed shoelace form is alternating: transpositions negate, cyclic rotations fix — full `S₃` symmetry after `|·|`.
- Every unit-disk triangle has area `≤ 3`, so `heilbronn n`'s `sSup` set is bounded above (a step toward finiteness/monotonicity of `heilbronn`).

### Reusable Lean recipe
- Signed-area alternation: `rw [show <permuted expr> = -(<base expr>) from by ring, abs_neg]`.
- Coordinate bound from the disk: `nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 - 1), sq_nonneg (p.1 + 1)]` after `have hsq : p.1^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg p.2]`.
- Three-term abs bound: `abs_add_le` twice (note `abs_add` was renamed to `abs_add_le` in this pin) + `gcongr`, each summand `≤ 2` via `mul_le_mul` on `|a|·|b−c| ≤ 1·2`.
- v4.31 renames hit this session: `abs_add → abs_add_le`, `Finset.not_mem_empty → Finset.notMem_empty`.

### Next steps
- `minTriangleArea P ≤ triangleArea p q r` (nested membership `biInf_le`).
- `heilbronn n ≤ 3` via `BddAbove` of the defining set.

### Still open (unchanged)
The growth exponent of `α(n)` — deep; only `7/6 ≤ β ≤ 2` known (KPS, Cohen–Pohoata–Zakharov).
